title: agent-workflows stage sequence (protocol 0.3)
description: Validates a `metadata.workflow` block that declares a stage's sequence: the stage's members — steps and gates — in record order, the order their records take in the run-state list that resume is defined over (spec sections 9.4, 8.5, and 10). Sibling structures and unknown keys are tolerated per the 0.x degradation rules (spec section 9.5).

sequence.description: The stage's members in record order (spec section 9.4). Completeness — every declared step and gate named exactly once — is a cross-surface semantic the conformance checks hold against the stage's own declarations; the schema sees one block at a time.

protocol.description: Protocol version this block was authored against, `<major>.<minor>` (spec section 11).

step.description: A step id the stage declares under a `###` heading (spec section 9.4).

gate.description: A gate id the stage declares in its Gates section (spec sections 7 and 9.4).

conditional.description: Marks a member populated `skipped` until a condition fires or a route returns to it (spec sections 9.4 and 10). Absence is the default — a member the run's path reaches — so `conditional: false` is not a form this schema admits.
